- memory_id "1000808": On 2025-11-03 the Boreal team noticed that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Boreal team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000804" [decision]: On 2025-11-03 the Boreal team decided that webhooks will sign payloads with rotating keys, because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000594": Priya Raman holds the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000582": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team on-call rotation, taking over from Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000387": On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the authentication gateway about the error rate.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000230": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the ledger service about the memory growth.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000011": The Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)

This is a reasonable correction since the constraint was tied to Lena being on-call. I think correcting it is appropriate.
